description: This file is a PHPUnit test class for the LeaveEntitlementService component within the OrangeHRM leave plugin module. It contains various test methods verifying the behavior of leave entitlement handling, including strategy retrieval, entitlement creation, deletion, and balance calculations, utilizing mock objects and fixtures.

classes.name: LeaveEntitlementServiceTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for testing the LeaveEntitlementService functionalities, including strategy retrieval, entitlement creation, deletion logic, balance computation, and bulk assignment operations with extensive mocking and fixture loading.

classes.name: TestEntitlementConsumptionStrategy
classes.description: A mock implementation of the EntitlementConsumptionStrategy interface used in tests to simulate leave period behavior.

classes.name: InvalidLeaveEntitlementConsumptionStrategy
classes.description: A placeholder class to test error handling when an invalid class is returned as a leave entitlement consumption strategy.

methods.name: testGetLeaveEntitlementStrategy
methods.description: Verifies that the service correctly retrieves and instantiates a valid leave entitlement consumption strategy class.

methods.name: testGetLeaveEntitlementStrategyNonExistClass
methods.description: Tests that an exception is thrown when the configuration points to a non-existent class name for the leave entitlement strategy.

methods.name: testGetLeaveEntitlementStrategyInvalidClass
methods.description: Checks that a TypeError is raised when the class specified does not implement the required interface.

methods.name: testGetLeaveEntitlementDao
methods.description: Asserts that the service returns an instance of LeaveEntitlementDao.

methods.name: testGetDeletableIdsFromEntitlementIds
methods.description: Tests the logic that filters leave entitlement IDs to identify deletable ones based on whether they are used or not.

methods.name: getDeletableIdsFromEntitlementIdsDataProvider
methods.description: Provides various datasets for testing the deletability logic with different entitlement usages.

methods.name: testGetLeaveBalanceWithDates
methods.description: Verifies that the leave balance fetching with specific date ranges works as expected.

methods.name: testGetLeaveBalanceWithOnlyEndDate
methods.description: Tests fetching leave balance with only an end date provided, ensuring the system defaults correctly.

methods.name: testGetLeaveBalanceWithOnlyAsAtDate
methods.description: Ensures that balance calculations based on a specific 'as at' date with leave period strategies behave correctly.

methods.name: testGetLeaveBalanceWithOnlyAsAtDateLeavePeriodNotForced
methods.description: Checks the behavior when leave period enforcement is disabled and only 'as at' date is provided.

methods.name: testAddEntitlementForEmployeeAsNew
methods.description: Verifies adding a new leave entitlement for an employee, ensuring credit date and no-of-days are correctly set.

methods.name: testAddEntitlementForEmployeeAsAdding
methods.description: Tests the addition of leave entitlement where existing entitlements are present, simulating an 'adding' operation.

methods.name: testAddEntitlementForEmployeeAsAddingWhenDeletedAlsoThere
methods.description: Ensures entitlement addition logic works correctly even if a previous entitlement is marked as deleted.

methods.name: testBulkAssignLeaveEntitlements
methods.description: Confirms that bulk assignment of leave entitlements correctly creates entitlements for multiple employees and returns accurate counts.

methods.name: loadFixtures
methods.description: Loads test fixture data from a YAML file into the database for the duration of tests.
